actual_scope.contact: source/qa/contact-sheet-extended.png, all 57 standard action cells, neutral cell and 16 look cells
actual_scope.focused: source/qa/look-directions.png, neutral plus all 16 labeled directions and enlarged face regions
actual_scope.motion: Decoded the actual final preview/ GIFs in sequence into native 192x208-frame montages. Inspected all 57 standard frames and the full clockwise 16-frame look sequence; repeated the two row/wrap boundaries in a separate native-size strip.

checks.identity_body_hat: pass: pale silver-green hair, lavender eyes, blue/gold broad pointed hat, white skirt, blue/gold coat, diagonal brown potion bandolier and brown boots remain the same character. Hat perspective changes with head pitch/yaw, without a conspicuous scale or identity pop. No extra eyes, limbs or replacement props seen.
checks.look_anchors: pass: boots stay planted in the same lower-center stance; torso, coat opening and diagonal bandolier retain their orientation. Head/hair/hat change while the body stays front-facing. No whole-sprite rotation used to fake gaze.
checks.cardinals: pass: 000 has symmetric raised eyes and upturned face with visible underside of the brim; 090 has nose/face and both eyes directed screen-right; 180 has lowered chin and low eyelids/irises beneath the brim while eyes remain visible; 270 has face/nose and both eyes directed screen-left. Horizontal and vertical pairs are distinctive at native pet size.
checks.ordered_semantics: pass with minor angular-spacing warning: up to upper-right to right to lower-right to down to lower-left to left to upper-left to up. No gross wrong quadrant or visible reversal seen.
checks.157.5_to_180: pass: lower-right head returns toward centered down-facing head; brim pitches farther forward, both eyes lower, and boots/torso stay anchored. This is a larger head-pose step than 135 to 157.5, but no conspicuous size, anatomy or registration snap.
checks.337.5_to_000: pass: upper-left head returns to centered up-facing head with both irises raised. Hat underside and chin remain coherent; body and boot placement do not pop across wrap.
checks.000_to_022.5: warning, minor: this head/hat yaw change is more pronounced than the next two upper-right steps. The face moves in the correct clockwise direction, identity remains stable and planted lower-body anchors avoid a whole-sprite jump.
checks.247.5_to_270: pass: face raises from down-left toward left while hat follows the head; no wrong direction, conspicuous scale jump or silhouette break despite the metric outlier.
checks.interior_holes: pass by contact/focused/native-sequence visual review: no accidental horizontal gaps or transparent holes in filled face, hat, torso, skirt or boots seen. Space between hair/arms/coat and between legs reads as intentional negative space. Also reviewed supplied continuity alphaHoles=[] evidence.
checks.clipping: pass: full hats, hair tips, hands, coat and boots fit within final cells; no neighboring-pose overlap seen.
checks.standard_actions: pass with minor left-gait warning: idle blink, alternating right/left travel, open-hand wave, crouch-hop-return, disappointed expression, requesting hand, planted focused work and chin-rest review remain readable and distinct. No reversed travel, frozen full loop, added effects, gross anatomy deformation or conspicuous body-size pop seen in final decoded sequences.
checks.chroma: Not re-adjudicated visually. Per review task, the successful final deterministic cleanup report and native atlas validation are authoritative. No additional cleanup or generation performed.

minor_issues.issue: Trailing knee stays visibly bent/high during several phases.
minor_issues.judgment: Minor stylized gait. Alternating extension/support phases and left-facing travel remain readable; independently confirmed in final GIF frames.

minor_issues.issue: 022.5, 045 and 067.5 share similar upward pitch; 000 to 022.5 contributes a larger yaw/hat-orientation step.
minor_issues.judgment: Minor uneven angular interpolation. Directions stay in the correct quadrant and flow toward the right cardinal; no visible reversal, identity change or anchored-body registration jump.

limitations: Motion judgment uses deterministic ordered decoded final-GIF frames at native size, including repeated boundary sequences; no continuous real-time playback or browser screenshot observation was performed in this review.
No Codex in-app import/display, installation, package or release verification was performed.
No additional alpha-mask connected-component analysis or independent chroma pass was run; the review task supplies final deterministic cleanup/native-validation acceptance.
